summary: Windstorms hit Weasua (Gbarpolu); Janplee, Garmue and Pantah (Bong); and Zoeplaygbor (Nimba). 298 homes severely damaged, over 1,000 people left homeless, two people seriously injured.
source: NDMA briefing, reported by allAfrica (21 Mar 2024)

summary: Violent windstorms struck 11 communities (6 in Nimba, 5 in Lofa). 139 houses partly and 74 fully destroyed; 85 host families sheltering displaced people. IFRC allocated CHF 376,239 for the response.
A windstorm tore off much of the roof of Sroh Yoolah Public School (Twan River District) and destroyed several classrooms; the school closed temporarily.
